name: Known Defect
description: A REQ assertion on an open known defect failed, or a MON scenario detected a behavior change. Review docs/known-defects.md.

name: Performance (SLA)
description: A non-functional performance requirement (SLA) is not met. Not a functional defect.

name: Product Defect
description: A functional requirement is not met. Performance (SLA:) failures are excluded on purpose.

name: Precondition
description: The scenario could not be prepared (Given step). Check /auth and POST /booking.

name: Infrastructure
description: The environment is unavailable. Re-run the whole execution later.

name: Infrastructure
description: The environment is unavailable. Re-run the whole execution later.

name: Test Defect
description: Error in the automation code or its configuration.
